Since, the occurrence of the accident, involvement of the offending  vehicle, the driving license, Insurance certificate etc. are not  disputed by the learned advocate representing the  appellant/insurance company, this Court restricts itself only to the  extent of considering the issue of route permit and the personal  deduction to the extent of 1/4th of the annual income.
